# Q-049: US dollars spent and sold with no `cost_basis_split_guid:` line, as a
# book that keeps no cost bases writes them.
#
# The fee spends 0.72 USD, valued 1.01. The sale of 1,000.00 USD was recorded
# at 1,350.00 and brought in 1,400.00 CAD, and its `$residual$` split states
# the realized gain, 50.00. A book keeping cost bases refuses both: each spend
# gives no cost basis.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_book_can_keep_no_cost_bases.py.
2026-08-20 * "Transfer fee"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Bank charges 1.01 CAD
	Assets:Wise USD -0.72 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		value: "-1.01"
2026-09-01 * "Dollars sold"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Wise USD -1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		value: "-1350.00"
	Assets:Chequing 1400.00 CAD
	Income:FX gain $residual$ CAD
